reviews.text: Jackelyn’s home grooming is top notch. She kept updating me with photos. Also, pick up and drop off was very smooth. She left my cat Otto so handsome. 120% will recommend to friends and family.

Jackelyn did a great job on my dog Mister. He was knotted in several areas and had some plaque on his teeth that needed to be cleaned. Jackelyn sent me pictures of my dog as she worked on him. I picked him up and my dog looked happy. I highly recommend her grooming service.

This was by far the best grooming experience Ziggy has had in 5 years! I was able to get a last minute appointment, while visiting NYC. Jackelyn communicated with text and photos throughout the service which was super comforting for our first visit.  And BONUS!!!!  She even cleaned his teeth. ☺️. We couldn’t be more grateful. A must go for your fur babies. Will 100% return on our next trip.

Jackelyn was so great!! I liked her right away!! And her service is smooth and thorough. She sent me pics of almost every step of grooming my cat! From sending me a pic of the nails she cut off to the used Q tip! I def recommend her .. she also gave my baby boy a Halloween bow and a snack ❤️ all for 40 bucks.. I will be returning to her!

First time taking my dog to a personal groomer and I had a good experience. The lady was friendly and sent pics updating progress of the grooming session. Also the location is in a safe area.
As far as the grooming went. My dog seems very happy and excited after the session. I'm not good with how styling suppose to look, but I think he looks good. Most importantly he's comfortable. So yes I would def recommend anyone needing a good groomer for your pets. Say hi to Monty!!

I’ll be honest, I’m always nervous about leaving my baby Kylo in someone else’s hands. I’m very particular about who I trust with him, but after hearing so many incredible things about Jackelyn, I couldn’t help but test the waters.

And I’m SO glad I did! Kylo looks absolutely amazing. You can truly tell that Jackelyn takes her time and genuinely cares about what she does. Her professionalism, patience, and the level of comfort she provides are truly 1 of 1.

I can confidently say I found Kylo a new full time groomer! Thank you again, Jackelyn, for taking such great care of my baby. We’ll definitely see you again in 2–3 weeks! 😊

I had such a great experience! She was absolutely amazing with my dog and had so much patience with him. My dog is very dramatic and does not like anyone touching him or doing anything to him, so grooming him can be quite a challenge. She was so gentle, patient, and caring with him, and I really appreciated how comfortable she made him feel.

He came out looking absolutely beautiful! 🥰 I’m so happy with how he looks and I will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend her, especially if you have a dog who is difficult or nervous during grooming. ❤️
Yes she is good in what she do I definitely recommend her services

Jackelyn did an amazing job with my anxious cat she worked fast and sent updates along the way. My cat is very sensitive and doesn’t like being touched for too long and despite being a bit difficult she still managed!
Jackelyn was hands down great with Treasure. He was so relaxed being his 1st time being groomed by her. I asked her to just do her THANG and that she DID!!!! Customer 4 LYFE!!!!!💯

Hubby took our yorkie Goliath for a complete grooming makeover as he was very overdue for one. She was very communicative and sent pictures during his appointment. We’re very happy with her work and will definitely be sending him back for his next grooming.
I took my cat to get her nails trimmed last week and it didn’t take long at all . I received updates and pictures while the service was being done . 10/10 highly recommend
Took my furbaby to her and she was wonderful and gave me updates on everything… I will definitely recommend her. I am definitely coming back.. thank you for everything…
Jackelyn did an excellent job! It was very comforting to receive update pictures throughout the grooming process. I would highly recommend her and would bring Buttercup back in the future.

Went to take my mom’s Cat Mazzi to Jackelyn! He is long haired and had matting that needed to be removed. However, Jackelyn went above and beyond! She showered, shampooed, recommended cut, trimmed nails…just the whole package at a very reasonable price. Mazzi was nervous going in as it’s his first grooming session. But, Jackelyn handled with such care he left appointment pleasant and at peace. Jackelyn is very prompt and professional! I definitely will be a returning customer!

This is my little girl Olivia and it’s been a little while since she’s seen Jackelyn but shes been getting her grooming done with Jackelyn for about 5 years now. The experience this time was just as seamless and satisfying as I remember. Jackelyn is reliable, quick, personable but professional all at the same time. I highly recommend.

Jackelyn did an absolutely amazing job grooming Mia! She looks so beautiful, fresh,  and adorable. 🥰 My daughter of 10 truly saw the care and attention to detail she puts into her grooming. Mia looks like a little princess! 👑🐾

Thank you, Jackelyn, for taking such great care of my baby girl. We are so happy with how beautiful she looks! 💕 I highly recommend Jackelyn to anyone looking for a loving and talented groomer
Amazing service will definitely be bringing my puppy back 😊

My cat, Boots, was in desperate need of a summer haircut. She was shedding a lot and had a bit of a matted area on her back. Boots can be a bit nervous and a little mean but Jackelyn was able to handle her, no problem. The service was quick and efficient and I really appreciated all of the constant communication around pickup/drop off times, pictures during the service, and updates on how Boots was doing/reacting/behaving. Jackelyn is great and I will absolutely be bringing my cat back to her.
